secrets.name: VITE_SUPABASE_URL
secrets.description: Supabase project URL, e.g. https://<project-ref>.supabase.co (Supabase dashboard > Project Settings > Data API). Only needed to point the preview at a different Supabase project than the one committed in .env.base44-defaults; set it together with VITE_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY.

secrets.name: VITE_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase publishable (anon) browser key for that project (Supabase dashboard > Project Settings > API keys). The app does not render without one; the sandbox falls back to the project's committed public browser key.

secrets.name: VITE_THIRDWEB_CLIENT_ID
secrets.description: Optional public thirdweb Client ID (https://thirdweb.com/dashboard) that enables the isolated Base Sepolia wallet preview on the Wallet screen. Never use a thirdweb secret key here.
